note: The compressed DWA chunk bytes from the EXR input are copied into the decompressor counters and the remaining chunk data is parsed from the same input buffer.
Because the input counter version is 2, decompression enters the v2 channel-rule parser with dataPtr pointing at the input-controlled rule block.
The two-byte ruleSize field is read from the candidate and determines how many following bytes are available to Classifier_read.
The parser passes the rule payload length derived from ruleSize to Classifier_read; the candidate supplies a long unterminated suffix payload.
After scanning 129 non-NUL bytes, len is incremented to 130, so the equality check misses the required upper bound that len must not exceed the 129-byte stack suffix buffer.
memcpy reads len bytes from the stack array suffix; with len equal to 130 and suffix only 129 bytes, this performs a stack out-of-bounds read.
